t: The DEWALT Bakesfield short sleeve t-shirt multipack offers essential workwear for trade professionals. This twin pack includes 1 olive and 1 navy t-shirt, providing versatile options for daily site wear or workshop tasks. Crafted from a durable 65% polyester and 35% cotton blend, these t-shirts are lightweight and breathable, ensuring comfort throughout the workday. Both garments feature bound ribbed crew neck collars and cuffs for a secure, comfortable fit and enhanced durability. Each t-shirt is finished with the iconic DEWALT chest logo, making them a practical and reliable addition to any workwear collection.
